css: .t10-shell{font:13px/1.4 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#172033;background:#f7f8fb;border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:16px;padding:15px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden}.t10-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:11px}.t10-head p{margin:0;color:#6c7688;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;font-size:10px}.t10-head h2{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:20px}.t10-head button{appearance:none;border:1px solid #cbd3df;background:white;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 9px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;color:#2848a5;cursor:pointer}.t10-overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr .7fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin-bottom:8px}.t10-overview>div,.t10-steers>div{background:white;border:1px solid #dde2ea;border-radius:9px;padding:9px;min-width:0}.t10-overview span,.t10-steers span{display:block;color:#697386;font-size:10px}.t10-overview strong,.t10-steers strong{display:block;margin-top:2px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.t10-steers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px;margin-bottom:10px}.t10-steers em{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:11px;font-style:normal;color:#667186}.t10-steers em.is-pass{color:#21653b}.t10-steers em.is-fail{color:#922d2d}.t10-columns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:10px}.t10-columns section{min-width:0}.t10-columns h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:13px}.t10-mounts,.t10-checks{display:grid;gap:5px}.t10-mount,.t10-check{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;background:white;border:1px solid #dde2ea;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 8px;min-width:0}.t10-mount span:first-child,.t10-check span:first-child{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.t10-pass,.t10-fail{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 7px}.t10-pass{background:#e7f7ee;color:#176b3a}.t10-fail{background:#fff0f0;color:#9a2f2f}@media(max-width:760px){.t10-columns{grid-template-columns:1fr}.t10-overview{grid-template-columns:1fr}.t10-steers{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
js: const activeEl=root.querySelector('[data-active]');const totalEl=root.querySelector('[data-total]');const countsEl=root.querySelector('[data-counts]');const mountsEl=root.querySelector('[data-mounts]');const checksEl=root.querySelector('[data-checks]');const steer1El=root.querySelector('[data-steer1]');const steer2El=root.querySelector('[data-steer2]');function taskRoot(n){const shell=document.querySelector('.t'+n+'-shell');return shell?shell.closest('.task-root'):null;}function badge(ok){const b=document.createElement('span');b.className=ok?'t10-pass':'t10-fail';b.textContent=ok?'PASS':'FAIL';return b;}function row(label,ok,cls){const r=document.createElement('div');r.className=cls;const t=document.createElement('span');t.textContent=label;r.append(t,badge(ok));return r;}function render(){const projects=api.getState('projects')||[];const activeId=api.getState('activeProjectId');const active=projects.find(p=>p.id===activeId);const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];const todo=tasks.filter(t=>t.status==='Todo').length;const doing=tasks.filter(t=>t.status==='Doing').length;const done=tasks.filter(t=>t.status==='Done').length;activeEl.textContent=active?(active.name||active.title||active.id):'Not found';totalEl.textContent=String(tasks.length);countsEl.textContent=todo+' / '+doing+' / '+done;const roots=Array.from({length:9},(_,i)=>taskRoot(i+1));mountsEl.replaceChildren(...roots.map((r,i)=>row('Task '+(i+1)+' root',!!r,'t10-mount')));const t4=taskRoot(4);const t7=taskRoot(7);const steer1Consumed=!!(t4&&t4.querySelector('.t4-tabs')&&/top tabs/i.test(t4.querySelector('.t4-mode')?.textContent||''));const steer2Consumed=!!(t7&&t7.querySelector('.t7-list')&&/edit directly/i.test(t7.querySelector('h2')?.textContent||''));steer1El.textContent='Task 4 consumed: '+(steer1Consumed?'Yes':'No');steer1El.className=steer1Consumed?'is-pass':'is-fail';steer2El.textContent='Task 7 consumed: '+(steer2Consumed?'Yes':'No');steer2El.className=steer2Consumed?'is-pass':'is-fail';const checks=[];roots.forEach((r,i)=>checks.push(['Task '+(i+1)+' is mounted in a .task-root',!!r]));checks.push(['Shared projects state is an array with 3 projects',Array.isArray(api.getState('projects'))&&projects.length===3]);checks.push(['activeProjectId resolves to a visible project',!!active]);checks.push(['Shared tasks state is an array',Array.isArray(api.getState('tasks'))]);checks.push(['Task status counts add up to total tasks',todo+doing+done===tasks.length]);checks.push(['Every task has id, title, owner, status, and due fields',tasks.every(t=>t&&typeof t.id==='string'&&typeof t.title==='string'&&typeof t.owner==='string'&&['Todo','Doing','Done'].includes(t.status)&&typeof t.due==='string')]);checks.push(['Task 1 active card matches activeProjectId',!!(taskRoot(1)?.querySelector('.t1-card.is-active[data-project-id="'+CSS.escape(String(activeId))+'"]'))]);checks.push(['Task 3 has live search/filter/sort controls',!!(taskRoot(3)?.querySelector('[data-search]')&&taskRoot(3)?.querySelector('[data-status]')&&taskRoot(3)?.querySelector('[data-owner]')&&taskRoot(3)?.querySelector('[data-sort]'))]);checks.push(['Steer 1 B is visibly realized by Task 4 top tabs',steer1Consumed]);checks.push(['Steer 2 A is visibly realized by Task 7 inline editor',steer2Consumed]);checks.push(['Task 8 exposes save, restore, clear, and undo controls',!!(taskRoot(8)?.querySelector('[data-save]')&&taskRoot(8)?.querySelector('[data-restore]')&&taskRoot(8)?.querySelector('[data-clear]')&&taskRoot(8)?.querySelector('[data-undo]'))]);checks.push(['Task 9 exposes separate export and import textareas',!!(taskRoot(9)?.querySelector('[data-export-text]')&&taskRoot(9)?.querySelector('[data-import-text]'))]);checksEl.replaceChildren(...checks.map(c=>row(c[0],c[1],'t10-check')));}root.querySelector('[data-refresh]').addEventListener('click',()=>{render();api.log(10,'Diagnostics refreshed');});render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);root.addEventListener('bci:unmount',unsubscribe,{once:true});
